units.source_text: 鹿苑寺的后面，从夕佳亭所在的地方再往东走，就是一座名叫不动山的山。

en.t: Behind Rokuon-ji, if you go farther east from the place where Sekkatei stands, there is a mountain called Fudo-yama.

units.source_text: 这座覆盖着赤松的山，在松林间夹杂着丛生的小矮竹，其中有水晶花和杜鹃花等灌木。

en.t: This mountain, covered with red pines, has clusters of low bamboo mixed among the pine woods, along with shrubs such as crystal flowers and azaleas.

units.source_text: 我十分熟悉这座山的路，就是摸黑登山也不至于被绊倒。

en.t: I knew the paths of this mountain so well that even if I climbed it in the dark, I would not stumble.

units.source_text: 登到山顶，就可以望及上京、中京、远方的茶山和大文字山。

en.t: When you reached the summit, you could see Kamigyo, Nakagyo, and, in the distance, Chayama and Mount Daimonji.
